title: Page through the todo list
goal: Clients with long lists can ask for one page at a time instead of the whole list.

acceptance_criteria.text: GET /todos?limit=n&offset=m returns at most n items starting after the first m, in the usual order; limit alone starts at the first item, offset alone returns the rest.
limit must be a whole number from 1 to 100 and offset a whole number of at least 0; any other value answers 400. GET /todos without them still returns every item.
